item.title: Pennsylvania police officer charged with voluntary manslaughter in killing of college student
item.description: A Pennsylvania police officer who fatally shot a 22-year-old college student, who had ended up at the wrong house late at night and was waiting for friends to pick him up, has been charged with voluntary manslaughter.
